raw_segments.text: Fourth Messenger. Sir Thomas Lovell and Lord Marquess Dorset, Tis said, my liege, in Yorkshire are in arms.

But this good comfort bring I to your Highness. The Breton navy is dispersed by tempest. Richmond, in Dorsetshire, sent out a boat Unto the shore, to ask those on the banks If they were his assistants, yea or no?— Who answered him they came from Buckingham Upon his party. He, mistrusting them, Hoised sail, and made his course again for Brittany.
